page.layout: Two parallel columns separated by a vertical rule, Hebrew-Latin dictionary entries. Left column: entries from the top to the bottom of the column. Right column: entries from the top to the bottom, ending with the section letters "מ ם" and the start of the next entry. No margin notes, no running head, no catchword, no signature.

page.notes: Page number at the top left is Hebrew-letter numerals, only partly legible. Several pointed Hebrew forms in both columns (e.g. the vowel points on מִנֶּסֶת, מִנְעָלְךָ, מִנְקִיּוֹתָיו, and the root נָוַח) are uncertain at this scan resolution; the consonantal skeletons are the most reliable part. Entry lines are copied line by line as set, with the printed hyphens kept on "mu-", "se-", "tu-", "amæ-", "mun-", "dissolu-". The "מ ם" line is a section marker in the right column, copied as a paragraph, not a heading. The vertical rule between the columns is not transcribed.
